purpose: Demonstrate a governed service-queue pattern that prepares routine categorization and assignment while requiring explicit human review for duplicate, priority, and permission-sensitive cases.
verified_operating_behaviors: five routine assignments separated from three exceptions
routine assignments confirmed as a group
urgency language cannot set service priority without review
permission-sensitive request is held outside the general queue
queue commit blocked until all controls are satisfied
final output accounts for all originals and reviewer decisions
reset restores a clean starting state
public maturity and non-claim boundary remains visible

acceptance.execution: Portfolio CI executes the Playwright suite across configured desktop, tablet, and mobile projects.

production_adaptation_requires: approved request channels and service taxonomy
accountable queue owners and service targets
baseline queue volume cycle time and rework measures
acceptance criteria training and administrator handoff
not_claimed: measured client service-level improvement or savings
autonomous priority setting for consequential requests
